Scientist David Hone makes the case for: In my view, it is perfectly possible for many species of animals living in zoos or wildlife parks to have a quality of life as high as, or higher than, in the wild.
科学家戴维·霍恩阐述支持动物园的理由。: 在我看来，许多动物生活在动物园或野生动物园里，生活质量完全可能与在野外一样高，甚至更高。

Scientist David Hone makes the case for: Animals in good zoos get a varied and high-quality diet with all the supplements required, and any illnesses they might have will be treated.
科学家戴维·霍恩阐述支持动物园的理由。: 好的动物园为动物提供多样化的优质食物，配齐所需的营养补充剂，动物生病了也会得到治疗。

Scientist David Hone makes the case for: Their movement might be somewhat restricted, but they have a safe environment in which to live, and they are spared bullying and social ostracism by others of their kind.
科学家戴维·霍恩阐述支持动物园的理由。: 它们的活动范围或许多少受到限制，但有安全的生活环境，也免遭同类欺凌或排斥。
column9: others of their kind|其他同类

Scientist David Hone makes the case for: They do not suffer from the threat or stress of predators, or the irritation and pain of parasites or injuries.
科学家戴维·霍恩阐述支持动物园的理由。: 它们不用面对捕食者的威胁或因此承受压力，也免受寄生虫或受伤带来的刺激和疼痛。

Scientist David Hone makes the case for: The average captive animal will have a greater life expectancy compared with its wild counterpart, and will not die of drought, of starvation or in the jaws of a predator.
科学家戴维·霍恩阐述支持动物园的理由。: 圈养动物的平均预期寿命比野外同类更长，而且不会因干旱、饥饿，或落入捕食者之口而丧命。
zoos|n. 动物园: wild counterpart|生活在野外的同类
column8: in the jaws of|死于……口中

Scientist David Hone makes the case for: A lot of very nasty things happen to truly ‘wild’ animals that simply don’t happen in good zoos, and to view a life that is ‘free’ as one that is automatically ‘good’ is, I think, an error.
科学家戴维·霍恩阐述支持动物园的理由。: 真正“野生”的动物会遭受许多可怕的事，在好的动物园里却根本不会遇到这些。所以我认为，把“自由”的生活想当然地等同于“好”的生活，是个错误。
zoos|n. 动物园: simply don’t happen|根本不会发生

Scientist David Hone makes the case for: Furthermore, zoos serve several key purposes.
科学家戴维·霍恩阐述支持动物园的理由。: 此外，动物园还有几项重要作用。

Scientist David Hone makes the case for: Firstly, zoos aid conservation.
科学家戴维·霍恩阐述支持动物园的理由。: 首先，动物园有助于物种保护。

Scientist David Hone makes the case for: Colossal numbers of species are becoming extinct across the world, and many more are increasingly threatened and therefore risk extinction.
科学家戴维·霍恩阐述支持动物园的理由。: 全球有数量惊人的物种正在灭绝，还有更多物种遭受的威胁不断加剧，也因此面临灭绝风险。
column6: increasingly threatened|受到日益严重的威胁

Scientist David Hone makes the case for: Moreover, some of these collapses have been sudden, dramatic and unexpected, or were simply discovered very late in the day.
科学家戴维·霍恩阐述支持动物园的理由。: 而且，有些种群骤减来得突然、幅度惊人，出乎意料；还有些直到事态已相当严重时才被发现。
column7: late in the day|到了很晚的时候

Scientist David Hone makes the case for: A species protected in captivity can be bred up to provide a reservoir population against a population crash or extinction in the wild.
科学家戴维·霍恩阐述支持动物园的理由。: 在圈养环境中受到保护的物种可以通过繁育扩大数量，形成储备种群，以防其野外种群骤减或灭绝。
makes the case for|陈述支持……的理由: bred up|通过繁育扩大数量

Scientist David Hone makes the case for: A good number of species only exist in captivity, with many of these living in zoos.
科学家戴维·霍恩阐述支持动物园的理由。: 有相当多的物种如今只存在于圈养环境中，其中许多就生活在动物园里。
Scientist|n. 科学家: A good number of|相当多的

Scientist David Hone makes the case for: Still more only exist in the wild because they have been reintroduced from zoos, or have wild populations that have been boosted by captive bred animals.
科学家戴维·霍恩阐述支持动物园的理由。: 还有更多物种之所以仍然生存在野外，是因为动物园曾把它们重新引入野外，或因为圈养繁育的个体壮大了野外种群。
column7: captive bred animals|圈养繁育的动物

Scientist David Hone makes the case for: Without these efforts there would be fewer species alive today.
科学家戴维·霍恩阐述支持动物园的理由。: 如果没有这些努力，今天尚存的物种将会更少。
Scientist|n. 科学家: Without these efforts|如果没有这些努力

Scientist David Hone makes the case for: Although reintroduction successes are few and far between, the numbers are increasing, and the very fact that species have been saved or reintroduced as a result of captive breeding proves the value of such initiatives.
科学家戴维·霍恩阐述支持动物园的理由。: 重新引入野外的成功案例虽然不多，但数量正在增加。单凭圈养繁育已使一些物种免于灭绝或得以回归野外这一事实，就足以证明这类行动的价值。
Scientist|n. 科学家: reintroduction successes|重新引入野外的成功案例
makes the case for|陈述支持……的理由: few and far between|少而罕见

Scientist David Hone makes the case for: Zoos also provide education.
科学家戴维·霍恩阐述支持动物园的理由。: 动物园也承担教育职能。

Scientist David Hone makes the case for: Many children and adults, especially those in cities, will never see a wild animal beyond a fox or pigeon.
科学家戴维·霍恩阐述支持动物园的理由。: 许多儿童和成年人，尤其是生活在城市里的人，除了狐狸或鸽子，可能一辈子都见不到其他野生动物。

Scientist David Hone makes the case for: While it is true that television documentaries are becoming ever more detailed and impressive, and many natural history specimens are on display in museums, there really is nothing to compare with seeing a living creature in the flesh, hearing it, smelling it, watching what it does and having the time to absorb details.
科学家戴维·霍恩阐述支持动物园的理由。: 诚然，电视纪录片越来越详尽，也越来越精彩，博物馆还展出了许多自然史标本。但亲眼看见活生生的动物，亲耳听、亲鼻闻、观察它在做什么，慢慢体会细节，这种体验的确无可比拟。
column7: nothing to compare with|没有什么能与……相比
column8: in the flesh|亲眼见到活体

Scientist David Hone makes the case for: That alone will bring a greater understanding and perspective to many, and hopefully give them a greater appreciation for wildlife, conservation efforts and how they can contribute.
科学家戴维·霍恩阐述支持动物园的理由。: 仅此一点就能帮助许多人增进了解、开阔视野，也有望让他们更加珍视野生动物，理解保护工作，并明白自己能怎样出一份力。

Scientist David Hone makes the case for: In addition to this, there is also the education that can take place in zoos through signs, talks and presentations which directly communicate information to visitors about the animals they are seeing and their place in the world.
科学家戴维·霍恩阐述支持动物园的理由。: 此外，动物园还可以通过说明牌、讲解和展示开展教育，直接告诉游客眼前看到的是什么动物，以及它们在自然界中占有什么位置。
column9: their place in the world|它们在自然界中的位置

Scientist David Hone makes the case for: This was an area where zoos used to be lacking, but they are now increasingly sophisticated in their communication and outreach work.
科学家戴维·霍恩阐述支持动物园的理由。: 动物园过去在这方面有所欠缺，如今在信息传达和面向公众的推广工作上却日益成熟。
Scientist|n. 科学家: used to be lacking|过去有所欠缺
column7: outreach work|面向公众的推广工作

Scientist David Hone makes the case for: Many zoos also work directly to educate conservation workers in other countries, or send their animal keepers abroad to contribute their knowledge and skills to those working in zoos and reserves, thereby helping to improve conditions and reintroductions all over the world.
科学家戴维·霍恩阐述支持动物园的理由。: 许多动物园也直接帮助其他国家培训保护工作者，或者派饲养员到国外，与当地动物园和保护区的工作人员分享知识和技能，从而改善世界各地的饲养条件，提高把动物重新引入野外的成效。

Scientist David Hone makes the case for: Zoos also play a key role in research.
科学家戴维·霍恩阐述支持动物园的理由。: 动物园在科研中也发挥着重要作用。
Scientist|n. 科学家: play a key role|发挥关键作用

Scientist David Hone makes the case for: If we are to save wild species and restore and repair ecosystems we need to know about how key species live, act and react.
科学家戴维·霍恩阐述支持动物园的理由。: 如果我们想保护野生物种、恢复并修复生态系统，就需要了解关键物种怎样生活、怎样行动，以及怎样作出反应。

Scientist David Hone makes the case for: Being able to undertake research on animals in zoos where there is less risk and fewer variables means real changes can be effected on wild populations.
科学家戴维·霍恩阐述支持动物园的理由。: 在动物园里研究动物，风险较低，也有较少的变量。这意味着研究成果有可能真正改变野外种群的状况。

Scientist David Hone makes the case for: Finding out about, for example, the oestrus cycle of an animal or its breeding rate helps us manage wild populations.
科学家戴维·霍恩阐述支持动物园的理由。: 比如，了解一种动物的发情周期或繁殖率，就能帮助我们管理它的野外种群。

Scientist David Hone makes the case for: Procedures such as capturing and moving at-risk or dangerous individuals are bolstered by knowledge gained in zoos about doses for anaesthetics, and by experience in handling and transporting animals.
科学家戴维·霍恩阐述支持动物园的理由。: 在动物园积累的麻醉剂用量知识，以及照料和运送动物的经验，能帮助人们更妥善地捕捉、转移处于危险中的动物个体，或本身带有危险性的个体。
column7: doses for anaesthetics|麻醉剂的用量

Scientist David Hone makes the case for: This can make a real difference to conservation efforts and to the reduction of human-animal conflicts, and can provide a knowledge base for helping with the increasing threats of habitat destruction and other problems.
科学家戴维·霍恩阐述支持动物园的理由。: 这些知识和经验能给保护工作和缓解人兽冲突带来切实帮助，也能为应对日益严重的栖息地破坏威胁及其他问题提供知识基础。
Scientist|n. 科学家: make a real difference|带来切实改变

Scientist David Hone makes the case for: In conclusion, considering the many ongoing global threats to the environment, it is hard for me to see zoos as anything other than essential to the long-term survival of numerous species.
科学家戴维·霍恩阐述支持动物园的理由。: 总之，考虑到全球环境持续面临多种威胁，在我看来，动物园对于众多物种的长期生存实属不可或缺。

Scientist David Hone makes the case for: They are vital not just in terms of protecting animals, but as a means of learning about them to aid those still in the wild, as well as educating and informing the general population about these animals and their world so that they can assist or at least accept the need to be more environmentally conscious.
科学家戴维·霍恩阐述支持动物园的理由。: 动物园的关键作用不只在于保护园内动物，还在于让我们通过了解它们帮助仍在野外的同类。动物园也让公众认识这些动物及其生存世界，从而出力保护，或至少认同增强环保意识的必要。
zoos|n. 动物园: as a means of|作为……的手段

Scientist David Hone makes the case for: Without them, the world would be, and would increasingly become, a much poorer place.
科学家戴维·霍恩阐述支持动物园的理由。: 如果没有动物园，世界会变得贫乏得多，而且会日益贫乏下去。
